properties.text: Fiat-Shamir challenge hash must include all verifier-relevant inputs to prevent selective forgery.
properties.assertion: forall batch_verify(comms, cells, proofs, idx): hash_input contains DOMAIN || BLOB_SIZE || CELL_SIZE || len(comms) || len(idx) || comms || idx || evals || proofs

properties.text: Batch KZG verification pairing equation must hold: e(LL, LR) == e(RL, G2) for valid proofs.
properties.assertion: forall valid(cells, proofs, comms): pairing_check([[g1_lincomb(proofs, r_powers), KZG_SETUP_G2_MONOMIAL[n]], [RL, neg(G2)]]) == true

properties.text: Commitment deduplication must preserve semantic equivalence — mapping indices must be bijective per unique commitment.
properties.assertion: forall dedup(comms_bytes): forall i,j: comms_bytes[i] == comms_bytes[j] <=> commitment_indices[i] == commitment_indices[j]

properties.text: All cell_indices must be validated < CELLS_PER_EXT_BLOB before use in verification or recovery.
properties.assertion: forall verify_batch(cell_indices): forall idx in cell_indices: 0 <= idx < CELLS_PER_EXT_BLOB

properties.text: All input list lengths must be equal before batch verification proceeds.
properties.assertion: forall verify_batch(comms, indices, cells, proofs): len(comms) == len(indices) == len(cells) == len(proofs)

properties.text: Each commitment byte array must be exactly BYTES_PER_COMMITMENT length before deserialization.
properties.assertion: forall verify_batch(comms_bytes): forall c in comms_bytes: len(c) == BYTES_PER_COMMITMENT

properties.text: Each cell must be exactly BYTES_PER_CELL length; each proof must be BYTES_PER_PROOF length.
properties.assertion: forall verify_batch(cells, proofs): forall c in cells: len(c) == BYTES_PER_CELL AND forall p in proofs: len(p) == BYTES_PER_PROOF

properties.text: Recovery requires at least CELLS_PER_EXT_BLOB/2 cells (50% erasure coding threshold).
properties.assertion: forall recover(cell_indices, cells): len(cell_indices) >= CELLS_PER_EXT_BLOB / 2

properties.text: Recovery cell_indices must be unique and sorted in ascending order.
properties.assertion: forall recover(cell_indices): is_sorted(cell_indices) AND is_unique(cell_indices)

properties.text: Recovered polynomial must have degree < FIELD_ELEMENTS_PER_BLOB (truncation correctness).
properties.assertion: forall recover(cell_indices, cells) -> poly: deg(poly) < FIELD_ELEMENTS_PER_BLOB

properties.text: Coset division in recovery must use coset shift to avoid division by zero on vanishing polynomial roots.
properties.assertion: forall recover: division_of(ez, zp) is computed over coset domain, not FFT domain where Z(x)==0

properties.text: Vanishing polynomial must evaluate to zero at all missing cell evaluation points and nonzero elsewhere.
properties.assertion: forall construct_vanishing(missing): forall x in missing_coset_points: Z(x) == 0 AND forall x in present_coset_points: Z(x) != 0

properties.text: Coset shift for each cell must use bit-reversal permuted roots at correct stride offset.
properties.assertion: forall cell_index: coset_shift_for_cell(cell_index) == bit_reversal_permutation(roots_of_unity(FIELD_ELEMENTS_PER_EXT_BLOB))[FIELD_ELEMENTS_PER_CELL * cell_index]

properties.text: cell_to_coset_evals and coset_evals_to_cell must be exact inverses for valid field elements.
properties.assertion: forall cell: coset_evals_to_cell(cell_to_coset_evals(cell)) == cell

properties.text: FFT input length must be a power of 2; mismatched lengths cause incorrect butterfly computation.
properties.assertion: forall _fft_field(vals, roots): is_power_of_2(len(vals)) AND len(vals) == len(roots)

properties.text: Inverse FFT must apply normalization factor 1/N and reverse roots order (except first element).
properties.assertion: forall fft_field(vals, roots, inv=True): result == [x * (1/len(vals)) for x in _fft_field(vals, reverse(roots[1:]))]

properties.text: Polynomial multiplication result degree must not exceed FIELD_ELEMENTS_PER_EXT_BLOB - 1.
properties.assertion: forall multiply(a, b): len(a) + len(b) - 1 <= FIELD_ELEMENTS_PER_EXT_BLOB

properties.text: Polynomial division divisor must not be the zero polynomial (leading coefficient nonzero).
properties.assertion: forall divide(a, b): b != [0] AND b[len(b)-1] != 0

properties.text: Lagrange interpolation requires all x-coordinates to be distinct for invertibility.
properties.assertion: forall interpolate(xs, ys): forall i != j: xs[i] != xs[j]

properties.text: Interpolated polynomial must evaluate to ys[i] at xs[i] for all input points.
properties.assertion: forall interpolate(xs, ys) -> p: forall i: evaluate(p, xs[i]) == ys[i]

properties.text: KZG multi-proof quotient Q(X) must satisfy f(X) = Q(X)*Z(X) + R(X) where R vanishes on evaluation points.
properties.assertion: forall compute_kzg_proof_multi(poly, zs): forall z in zs: evaluate(poly, z) == evaluate(remainder, z)

properties.text: Bit-reversal permutation must be applied before inverse FFT in polynomial_eval_to_coeff.
properties.assertion: forall polynomial_eval_to_coeff(poly): applies bit_reversal_permutation(poly) before fft_field(inv=True)

properties.text: Blob input must be exactly BYTES_PER_BLOB before cell computation or proof generation.
properties.assertion: forall compute_cells_and_kzg_proofs(blob): len(blob) == BYTES_PER_BLOB

properties.text: compute_cells must produce exactly CELLS_PER_EXT_BLOB cells from a valid blob.
properties.assertion: forall compute_cells(blob) -> cells: len(cells) == CELLS_PER_EXT_BLOB

properties.text: Each cell-proof pair from compute_cells_and_kzg_proofs must individually pass verify_cell_kzg_proof_batch.
properties.assertion: forall compute_cells_and_kzg_proofs(blob) -> (cells, proofs): verify_cell_kzg_proof_batch(commit(blob), range(CELLS_PER_EXT_BLOB), cells, proofs) == true

properties.text: Recovered cells and proofs must be identical to originally computed cells and proofs for the same blob.
properties.assertion: forall blob, subset >= 50%: recover_cells_and_kzg_proofs(subset) == compute_cells_and_kzg_proofs(blob)

properties.text: P2P peers are untrusted; all cell data, proofs, and indices from peers must be fully validated.
properties.assertion: forall peer_message(cells, proofs, indices): validated(cells) AND validated(proofs) AND validated(indices) before use

properties.text: KZG trusted setup parameters are binding; compromised setup invalidates all proof verification.
properties.assertion: KZG_SETUP_G1_MONOMIAL and KZG_SETUP_G2_MONOMIAL are outputs of honest trusted setup ceremony

properties.text: Engine API blob data is semi-trusted; blobs from EL must still pass KZG commitment verification.
properties.assertion: forall blob from EL: verify_blob_kzg_proof(blob, commitment) == true before propagation

properties.text: Domain separator in Fiat-Shamir must be RANDOM_CHALLENGE_KZG_CELL_BATCH_DOMAIN to prevent cross-protocol replay.
properties.assertion: forall compute_challenge: hash_input starts with RANDOM_CHALLENGE_KZG_CELL_BATCH_DOMAIN

properties.text: Forward coset FFT must shift-then-FFT; inverse must FFT-then-unshift (order is critical).
properties.assertion: forall coset_fft(vals, inv=False): result == fft(shift(vals, PRIMITIVE_ROOT)) AND coset_fft(vals, inv=True) == unshift(ifft(vals), PRIMITIVE_ROOT.inv())

properties.text: Vanishing polynomial coefficient spacing must be FIELD_ELEMENTS_PER_CELL for correct domain extension.
properties.assertion: forall construct_vanishing: zero_poly_coeff[i * FIELD_ELEMENTS_PER_CELL] == short_zero_poly[i] AND zero_poly_coeff[j] == 0 for j % FIELD_ELEMENTS_PER_CELL != 0

properties.text: At least one cell must be present for recovery; construct_vanishing_polynomial fails on all-missing input.
properties.assertion: forall recover(cell_indices): len(cell_indices) > 0 AND len(cell_indices) <= CELLS_PER_EXT_BLOB

properties.text: Coset for each cell must contain exactly FIELD_ELEMENTS_PER_CELL elements from bit-reversal permuted roots.
properties.assertion: forall coset_for_cell(idx) -> coset: len(coset) == FIELD_ELEMENTS_PER_CELL

properties.text: Batch verification weight accumulation must correctly sum r_powers per unique commitment index.
properties.assertion: forall verify_batch: weights[commitment_indices[k]] == sum(r_powers[j] for j where commitment_indices[j] == commitment_indices[k])

properties.text: Validator custody requirement must be clamped between VALIDATOR_CUSTODY_REQUIREMENT and NUMBER_OF_CUSTODY_GROUPS.
properties.assertion: forall get_custody_req(indices) -> r: VALIDATOR_CUSTODY_REQUIREMENT <= r <= NUMBER_OF_CUSTODY_GROUPS

properties.text: Custody requirement calculation must use integer division of total balance by BALANCE_PER_ADDITIONAL_CUSTODY_GROUP.
properties.assertion: forall get_custody_req(indices): count == sum(effective_balance[i] for i in indices) // BALANCE_PER_ADDITIONAL_CUSTODY_GROUP

properties.text: Each blob must produce exactly CELLS_PER_EXT_BLOB cell-proof pairs in cells_and_kzg_proofs construction.
properties.assertion: forall cells_and_kzg_proofs_construction(blobs): len(result) == len(blobs) * CELLS_PER_EXT_BLOB

properties.text: Proof slicing indices in cells_and_kzg_proofs_construction must always be within blobs_bundle.proofs bounds.
properties.assertion: forall blob_i: start == i * CELLS_PER_EXT_BLOB AND end == (i+1) * CELLS_PER_EXT_BLOB AND end <= len(blobs_bundle.proofs)

properties.text: get_data_column_sidecars must produce exactly NUMBER_OF_COLUMNS sidecars.
properties.assertion: forall get_data_column_sidecars(...) -> sidecars: len(sidecars) == NUMBER_OF_COLUMNS

properties.text: Each DataColumnSidecar.index must equal its positional column_index in the iteration.
properties.assertion: forall get_data_column_sidecars -> sidecars: sidecars[i].index == i for all i in range(NUMBER_OF_COLUMNS)

properties.text: Each sidecar must contain exactly one cell and one proof per blob in the block.
properties.assertion: forall sidecar in sidecars: len(sidecar.column) == len(kzg_commitments) AND len(sidecar.kzg_proofs) == len(kzg_commitments)

properties.text: cells_and_kzg_proofs length must equal kzg_commitments length before sidecar construction.
properties.assertion: forall get_data_column_sidecars: len(cells_and_kzg_proofs) == len(kzg_commitments)

properties.text: Merkle inclusion proof must bind blob_kzg_commitments to the signed block header.
properties.assertion: forall get_data_column_sidecars_from_block: kzg_commitments_inclusion_proof == compute_merkle_proof(body, generalized_index(blob_kzg_commitments))

properties.text: Each sidecar must be published to exactly one deterministically computed subnet based on column_index.
properties.assertion: forall sidecar: publish_topic == data_column_sidecar_{compute_subnet_for_data_column_sidecar(sidecar.index)}

properties.text: Sidecars must be retained for at least MIN_EPOCHS_FOR_DATA_COLUMN_SIDECARS_REQUESTS epochs.
properties.assertion: forall sidecar: current_epoch - sidecar_epoch <= MIN_EPOCHS_FOR_DATA_COLUMN_SIDECARS_REQUESTS => sidecar is stored AND served on request

properties.text: Optimized batch verification must produce the same accept/reject as individual cell KZG proof verification.
properties.assertion: forall cells, proofs, comms: verify_cell_kzg_proof_batch(comms, indices, cells, proofs) == AND(verify_cell_kzg_proof(comms[k], indices[k], cells[k], proofs[k]) for all k)

properties.text: Optimized FFT-based recovery must produce identical polynomial as naive Lagrange interpolation.
properties.assertion: forall available_cells: recover_polynomialcoeff(cells) == naive_interpolation(cells) for poly degree < FIELD_ELEMENTS_PER_BLOB

properties.text: CosetEvals output must have exactly FIELD_ELEMENTS_PER_CELL elements after cell deserialization.
properties.assertion: forall cell_to_coset_evals(cell) -> evals: len(evals) == FIELD_ELEMENTS_PER_CELL

properties.text: Cell byte segment slicing must use exactly BYTES_PER_FIELD_ELEMENT stride per element.
properties.assertion: forall cell_to_coset_evals: start == i * BYTES_PER_FIELD_ELEMENT AND end == (i+1) * BYTES_PER_FIELD_ELEMENT

properties.text: Horner's method evaluation must equal direct polynomial evaluation sum(coeff[i]*z^i).
properties.assertion: forall evaluate(poly, z): horner_result == sum(poly[i] * z**i for i in range(len(poly)))

properties.text: Vanishing polynomial must be monic (leading coefficient is 1) and have degree exactly len(xs).
properties.assertion: forall vanishing(xs) -> p: p[len(xs)] == 1 AND deg(p) == len(xs)
